notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures, one of which must be an artifact creature and have a power of one or greater.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any artifact creature with power one or greater, adding {C}{C}.
Death's Presece triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on any creature you control equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
